selected: UR5e, fixed .85m mount canted20deg, four powered wheels, guarded floor tether, no battery

combinations.price_scope: 2023 FR5-SPARK restricted education offer,1000 units; not current general sale
combinations.decision: preferred cost-down candidate; no admitted FR5 geometry, mounting-specific envelope or power-loss evidence in this run; cannot transfer UR witnesses
plausible longer reach; no primary China price or mounting-specific envelope verified

combinations.price_scope: 2022 CSU procurement:140000 arm+30000 controller+10000 pendant; historical, not a2026 quote
combinations.decision: selected verification baseline: complete inherited geometry and rated-CoM documentation; price premium not justified for manufacture until cheaper arm qualified

cart.ballast: 25mm total steel plate thickness in50mm case;0.54x0.44m plates at7850kg/m3; secured low in chassis
cart.mass_note: OEM collision/inertia model arm differs from catalogue20.6kg; actual compiled masses used for statics. Structural18kg budget includes brake carriers; final CAD mass distribution unqualified.

drive.mode: four-wheel skid steer; small yaw range+-0.18rad; body yaw sampled then frozen per stroke
drive.brake: 4x Mayr ROBA-stop M spring-applied8Nm through custom1:1 hub-ring/offset brake rotor carrier; de-energize-to-apply
drive.brake_open_issue: OEM hub spindle is stationary. A separate rotating-hub coupling is mandatory. Its CAD/envelope and proof strength are NOT yet qualified; source does not imply integrated hub brake.
drive.floor: level, dry, no thresholds; compliant tyres/equalising chassis must retain four-point contact; statics conditional

mount.reason: Fixed-height map .70/.80/.85/.95/1.00/1.15m. Repeated failures are station/gripper collisions and upright envelope degeneracy; no evidence that a lift solves them. No lift purchased or credited.

localization.mechanism: two hard docking stops and fiducial pose refinement; stationary wheel brakes before every stroke
localization.status: engineering accuracy target, not measured; nearly consumes5mm pose gate before calibration

gripper.note: Conservative full OEM housing added to inherited80mm-wide palm/fingers.150N/15Nm key rule unchanged; OEM7Nm moment limit is an additional unresolved mechanical interface constraint, not silently upgraded to15Nm. Fingers require commodity-food cushioning and verification.

tether.retraction: spring rewind with half-turn ratchet; not a continuous-duty robotic reel
tether.routing: guarded toe channel x=-1.8..2.8,y=-.04..-.01,z=0...03; short front branch with20mm sag envelope; no loop across standing aisle
tether.tension_status: design requirement for clutch/tension sensor, not published reel force
tether.pinch_trip: fixed rounded channel cover, inlet shroud, encoder/tension fault stop, presence inhibition; stop and intentional reset before anyone enters front gap
tether.limitation: Manual cautions high tractive forces. Ratchet release/fairlead tracking and continuous automatic retrieval remain unqualified; powered constant-tension reel may be required. No automated retraction success claimed.

power.appliance_scope: P16+valve+washer pump+greens/wedger allowances; independent dry power track, not reel; no heater
power.note: 924W excludes unverified four brake release coils. 1000W coiled reel has insufficient demonstrated reserve until actual coil/driver losses and limiting behavior are closed; peak rating is not granted from3500W fully unwound figure.

safety.restart: manual intentional reset after cleared occupancy/doors/cable fault; no automatic resume

parking.status: site assumption only; photos do not prove end alcove
parking.door_sweeps: all upper/lower cabinet/oven sweeps remain x<=1.8; parked robot x>=1.81 is separating-axis certificate
